name: U.S. Department of Energy, Solar Energy Technologies Office (now listed under the Integrated Energy Systems Office)
program: Solar funding notices: past agrivoltaics calls FARMS and SolWEB2, and any new solar notice
collect_note: Grants.gov is checked twice a day for DOE Golden Field Office notices (the office that issued FARMS and SolWEB2) with solar, photovoltaic or agrivoltaic in the title, including notices of intent, and they wait for review. Nothing is open today: DOE posts no upcoming solar notice, so the next solar call is caught the day it is posted. Prizes such as LASSO run outside Grants.gov and are only seen through the watched funding page.
